answer_card.title: ansible-core 2.21 → 2.22 overview
answer_card.answer_md: The ansible-core **2.22** porting guide lists behaviour changes since **2.21** that may require updates to playbooks, plugins and other content. Read it together with the ansible-core 2.22 changelog.
